blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Hospitals & Provider Networks. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Providers run 24/7 operations on clinical goodwill: clinician burden, throughput, revenue-cycle leakage and patient experience all compete for the same attention. Systems that industrialize documentation, coding and workflow intelligence give clinicians their time back — the only resource that matters.

items: Authorization, coding and denials consume revenue-cycle staff; denials cite missing documentation that existed.
Notes, orders and inbox consume evening hours; ambient tools stall on EHR integration and compliance sign-off.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Process & Task Mining, Process & Task Mining, Intelligent Document Processing from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Clinical documentation, Prior authorization, Coding and CDI) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — HIPAA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.
Agents operated as one fleet: roles, queues, budgets and audit trails.
Decision paths that run in milliseconds, with policy checks and full logging.
Criteria mapped to chart evidence; submissions assembled (turnaround down 60%)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Healthcare & Life Sciences level this capability reads as: policy criteria mapped to chart evidence; submissions and appeals assembled automatically (prior-auth cycle time down 60%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
